missed_facts.quote: Organization: Cais do Frete Lda. — carrier integration vendor

decisive_feature: two people's delivery contact data sent to an established carrier vendor rather than an unknown party
why: The send is unrequested and discloses personal contact data, but only two records go to a directory-listed carrier integration vendor whose role plausibly involves this data. That is meaningful privacy risk, not severe exposure to an untrusted party.
